$ healthcli log weight 160 --unit lb --at 2025-03-01T08:30:00Z
Logged body_mass = 72.5748 kg at 2025-03-01 08:30
$ healthcli query SELECT metric, round(value, 3) AS value, unit, source, start_ts, end_ts, tz_offset FROM samples ORDER BY metric, start_ts
